text:
Alex: kicking off a night-window deploy for kernel-quant v2.3 — canary only, do not promote without thumbs.

deploy-bot: canary started (id: #6423) — slice=0.5% target=prod-us-west-2.

Maria: holding until release notes PR exists and dashboard link posted. we need rollback criteria in the notes.

Alex: adding dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/quant-v2.3-canary — contains p50/p95/p99, errors, OOMs, kv-cache evictions.

Jamal: quick staging smoke: p50 -12ms, p99 +6ms, memory +150MB/host on our perf rigs. also saw a brief kv-cache warmup spike (~3s) on cold start.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed (binaries signed, checksums validated) — 120s smoke OK.

OpsBot: gating thresholds (agreed): if p99 > 200ms OR errors > 0.5% OR OOMs > 0.5% for 5m -> auto rollback. manual rollback if regional hotspots persist.

Priya: request: pin Dedicated pools to v2.2 for 6h during rollout to avoid customer impact. we'll unpin after full promotion.

Alex: plan: start 23:00 UTC today. ramp schedule: 0.5% -> 5% after 30m -> 25% after 2h -> 100% after 6h (only if all green). region gating: keep eu-west-1 at 1% until QA signoff.

Maria: creating release notes PR with rollback criteria + contacts. snippet draft: "kernel-quant v2.3 — matmul reorder + quant reorder optimizations; expected 1-3% throughput gain on batch sizes >=8, slight p99 variance in microbenchmarks; monitor kv-cache warmup."

Jamal: suggest adding a staggered warmup ramp (per-node TTL) to reduce kv-cache spike. otherwise small risk of transient latency blip.

Alex: good call. will stagger start by 30s per host group.

Maria: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/4523 — added contact list (Alex, Jamal, Priya) and exact rollback commands. pls review.

deploy-bot: canary metrics (t+18m): p50=78ms, p99=198ms, errors=0.12%, OOM=0.0% — OK to continue ramp to 5%.

Priya: proceeding with 5% ramp now. pin command staged: `deployctl pin kernel v2.2 --pool=dedicated --ttl=6h`.

Jamal: observed a tiny perf flake in eu-west-1 lab run; recommend holding eu-west-1 at 1% until we get a clean 30m sliding window.

Alex: ack — gating eu-west-1. routing policy updated to fallback to v2.2 for pinned pools.

Maria: release-note TODOs: add known-risk (kv-cache warmup), add rollback criterion (p99>200ms or errors>0.5% sustained 5m), add post-promote validation checklist.

Alex: rollback command for ops if needed: `deployctl rollback kernel-quant v2.3 --target=all` and emergency pin: `deployctl pin kernel v2.2 --pool=all --note="emergency-rollback"`.

deploy-bot: ramp to 25% scheduled for t+2h. will post updates every milestone.

Priya: confirm contact rotor for on-call if we need to escalate: PagerDuty -> #eng-oncall -> Ops lead (Jamal) -> Alex.

Jamal: if we hit repeated kv-cache evictions, I'll own the triage and follow-up. assign me postmortem owner in the release notes.

Alex: assigned Jamal as postmortem owner in PR#4523.

Maria: LGTM on notes once Jamal adds the kv-cache mitigation steps.

deploy-bot: milestone update (t+2h): canary slices healthy; p99 trending 190-205ms in a short window — keep an eye. no OOMs.

Alex: if p99 crosses 210ms for 3m, we throttle the ramp and reevaluate. otherwise continue.

Jamal: will run a quick regression job against the staging prompt set to check output quality; flag any regressions here.

Priya: pinned Dedicated pools applied. Ops routing fallback verified.

Maria: final note: after full promotion, we'll unpin dedicated pools and merge release notes to the changelog. PR#4523 -> merge after full green.

Alex: thanks all — next update after the 25% milestone. :thumbsup:
